title: Text: DET Marc Himelstein ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Marc, I am sorry to hear about this. My line is open if you want to talk about this, on-record, off-record, not for use or whatever. This seems fishy.
How did you hear about it
Obviously can’t name names, but multiple people currently employed by the organization contacted me yesterday afternoon
What did those people tell you
That they fired you
These people were in support of me?
Yes
Hey just following up. Gotta write about this and I just want to make sure I’m being fair to everyone involved
You are writing about me getting fired?
Yes
Others or just me
For now, just you, is the best way I can describe it. Again, I know this is a sensitive situation, but I need to give you the chance to talk to me. Certain people have certain agendas
Why is it just about be?
Me
Because you got fired
But lots of people have. Why just me
I thought you said all your calls were is support of me
That was 3 hrs ago
So there are calls against me
I know this is probably the worst thing ever for you
And I don’t know you that well but you’ve always been nice to me and you don’t seem like you’re a bad dude. So some of this stuff isn’t adding up
Give me a call if you have a chance, I can try to be more specific. Im not putting you on the record or anything
